name: Husaberg FE / TE
engine: 249 to 565 cc liquid-cooled single, four-stroke (FE) or two-stroke (TE)
intro: The Swedish-born enduros, later built by KTM. FE models are four-strokes, TE are two-strokes.

B: TE models are two-strokes that run premix. FE models are four-strokes. Check which one you have.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
